tasks.subject: Task 2: Create AnimatedContourBackground component
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Component renders the animated <object> embed only when appropriate; otherwise renders unchanged PageBackground, which also serves as the load-time underlay.

**Files:** Create components/ui/AnimatedContourBackground.tsx; Test __tests__/AnimatedContourBackground.test.tsx

**Verify:** npm test -- __tests__/AnimatedContourBackground.test.tsx → all passing

```json:metadata
{"files": ["components/ui/AnimatedContourBackground.tsx", "__tests__/AnimatedContourBackground.test.tsx"], "verifyCommand": "npm test -- __tests__/AnimatedContourBackground.test.tsx", "acceptanceCriteria": ["object+underlay when light/mounted/motion-ok", "no object dark", "no object pre-mount", "no object missing src", "no object reduced-motion", "underlay removed after load", "object non-interactive"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Wire into home + interests pages and verify animation in Chrome
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Swap PageBackground for AnimatedContourBackground on home + interests, and prove in a real browser that the glow runs in light mode while dark/other pages are unchanged.

**USER-ORDERED GATE — NON-SKIPPABLE.** Close only after every acceptanceCriteria item is re-validated independently with output captured.

**Files:** Modify app/page.tsx, app/interests/page.tsx

**Verify:** npm run dev; Chrome SMIL-clock probe per page/mode; npm test full suite green

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/page.tsx", "app/interests/page.tsx"], "verifyCommand": "npm test && (manual: Chrome SMIL-clock probe per Step 4-5)", "acceptanceCriteria": ["home light object SMIL clock advances ~4s", "interests light object SMIL clock advances ~4s", "home dark no object visually unchanged", "portfolio no object dual mirror intact", "reduced-motion emulated no object", "npm test full suite passes"], "userGate": true, "tags": ["user-gate"], "gateScope": "all-listed-pages-and-modes", "requireEvidenceTokens": [["light", "animating", "advancedBy"], ["dark", "static", "no object"]]}
```
